items.title: Section: The Same Method Applied to Loving-Kindness — Expanding to Boundless Beings

items.zh: 依慈愍觀初修業者，於外親品、怨品及中庸品，善取相已，處如法坐。由利益安樂增上意樂俱行定地作意，先於一親、一怨、一中庸所發起勝解。於此三品，由平等利益安樂增上意樂俱行作意，欲與其樂。如是念言：願彼求樂諸有情類，皆當得樂。謂或無罪欲樂，或無罪有喜樂，或無罪無喜樂。
items.en: "For a beginner cultivating loving-kindness contemplation: having skilfully grasped the marks of an external loved one, an enemy, and a neutral person, seat yourself properly. Through mental engagement fixed in concentration, joined with the heartfelt wish for their benefit and happiness, first generate vivid understanding with respect to one loved one, one enemy, and one neutral person. Towards these three categories, with mental engagement joined equally with the wish for their benefit and happiness, wish to give them happiness. Reflect thus: 'May all these beings who seek happiness attain happiness' — whether blameless sensory pleasure, blameless pleasure with joy, or blameless pleasure free of joy."

items.zh: 次後或於二親，或於三親，或於四親，或於五親、十親、二十、三十，如前乃至遍諸方維，其中親品充滿無間發起勝解，於中乃至無有容受一杖端處。如於親品，如是於怨及中庸品，當知亦爾。
items.en: "Next, extend to two loved ones, three, four, five, ten, twenty, thirty, and so on as before, up through all directions and quarters, generating uninterrupted vivid understanding filling every place with loved ones, until there is not even room for the tip of a walking staff. As with the category of loved ones, so too, it should be known, with the categories of enemies and neutral persons."

items.title: Loving-Kindness Enters the Four Foundations: Mixed-Object and Body-Only Mindfulness

items.zh: 又彼不捨慈愍加行，即由修習如是慈愍，於諸念住能正趣入。云何趣入？謂趣入時，應當發起如是勝解：如彼於我謂親、謂怨、謂中庸品，我既欲樂、厭背其苦。如是名為於其內身修循身觀。餘亦於彼、謂親、謂怨、謂中庸品；如我，彼亦欲樂、背苦。如是名為於其外身修循身觀。如我既爾，彼諸有情亦復如是。如我自欲求得勝樂，彼諸有情亦復如是。彼諸有情與己平等、與己相似，我當與彼利益安樂。如是名為於內外身修循身觀。
items.en: "Further, without abandoning the practice of loving-kindness, through this very cultivation of loving-kindness, one is able to rightly enter the foundations of mindfulness … Upon entering, one should generate this vivid understanding: 'Just as this person is, to me, a loved one, an enemy, or a neutral person, I myself likewise wish for happiness and turn away from suffering.' This is called cultivating contemplation of the body with respect to the inner body … 'Just as I am thus, so too are all these beings' … 'I shall give them benefit and happiness.' This is called cultivating contemplation of the body with respect to both inner and outer.

items.zh: 此四念住，總緣諸蘊為境界故，當知說名壞緣念住。若修行者但取色相，謂取顯相、形相、表相，於親品、怨品及中庸品而起勝解，由此建立唯身念住。
items.en: Since these four foundations of mindfulness take all the aggregates together as their object, this should be known as mixed-object mindfulness. If the practitioner takes up only the mark of form — that is, colour, shape, and outward appearance — generating vivid understanding of the loved one, the enemy, and the neutral person on this basis alone, this establishes body-only mindfulness.

items.zh: 彼復依止勝解作意，能正趣入真實作意。謂趣入時起是勝解：我於乃至無量有情，發起勝解，利益安樂增上意樂。

items.title: Section: True-Reality Engagement Applied to Loving-Kindness — No Relationship Is Fixed

items.zh: 如是我從先際已來，所有親品、怨品及中庸品落謝過去諸有情類，其數無量，甚過今者勝解所作。如是過去諸有情類，為我親已，復為我怨；為我怨已，復為我親；為怨、親已，復為中庸；為中庸已，復為怨、親。由是義門，一切有情平等平等，無有少分親性、怨性及中庸性，而非真實。由是因緣，遍於三品起平等心，平等應與利益安樂。
items.en: "Thus, from beginningless time, the loved ones, enemies, and neutral persons I have known, who have since passed away, number beyond measure — far exceeding what confident understanding alone constructs. And these past beings, having once been my loved ones, later became my enemies; having been my enemies, later became my loved ones; having been either, later became neutral; and having been neutral, later became either again. By this reasoning, all beings are utterly equal — there is not the slightest true reality to the nature of 'loved one,' 'enemy,' or 'neutral.' For this reason, one gives rise to an equal mind towards all three categories, and should equally bestow benefit and happiness upon them."

items.zh: 如從先際，如是後際於生死中當復流轉，應知亦爾。又我於彼先際已來諸有情類，未曾發起慈愍之心；彼皆過去，今起慈愍復有何益？但為除遣自心垢穢，令得清淨。故起念言：當令過去諸有情類皆得安樂。諸未來世非曾有者，亦皆令彼當得安樂。如是趣入真實作意慈愍住中，諸福滋潤、諸善滋潤；望前所修勝解作意慈愍住中所獲福聚；彼於百分不及此一，彼於千分不及此一，彼於數分、算分、計分、鄔波尼殺曇分不及此一。餘如前說。又於緣性緣起觀中初修業者，由聞思慧增上力故，分別取相。

items.title: Section: Dependent-Origination Contemplation — Grasping the Mark of Delusion's Fourfold Distortion

items.zh: 謂諸有情，由有種種無智愚癡，現見無常，妄計為常；現見不淨，妄計為淨；現見其苦，妄計為樂；現見無我，妄計為我；彼諸有情，有如是等種種顛倒；顛倒為因，於現法受及後所生諸自體中，發起貪愛；由貪愛故，造作種種生根本業；此煩惱、業為因緣故，感得當來純大苦蘊。
items.en: "Beings, through various kinds of ignorance and delusion, directly perceive impermanence yet falsely conceive it as permanent; directly perceive impurity yet falsely conceive it as pure; directly perceive suffering yet falsely conceive it as pleasure; directly perceive the absence of self yet falsely conceive a self. Possessed of such distortions, and with distortion as their cause, they give rise to craving with respect to both their present experience and their future embodiment; through craving, they perform the fundamental karma that generates rebirth; and through this karma and affliction as cause and condition, they bring about the entire mass of suffering to come."

items.zh: 彼既善取如是相已，復於其內發起勝解。

blocks.text: The same method (vivid understanding, then true-reality reflection, then the foundations of mindfulness) applied to loving-kindness and dependent origination. A passage (0463b01) is untranslated.

"Having grasped the marks of one loved one, one enemy, one neutral person", one sits and, "with the heartfelt wish for their benefit and happiness", wishes them "blameless sensory pleasure, blameless pleasure with joy, or blameless pleasure free of joy". Then two, three, ten, twenty, "up through all directions, until there is not even room for the tip of a walking staff".
"Just as this person wishes for happiness, so do I." Taking all the aggregates as object, this is "mixed-object mindfulness"; taking only form (colour, shape, appearance), "body-only".

"From beginningless time, the loved ones, enemies, and neutral persons I have known number beyond measure. Having been my loved ones, they later became my enemies; having been enemies, loved ones." So one gives rise to an equal mind towards all three.

"Beings directly perceive impermanence yet conceive it as permanent; impurity as pure; suffering as pleasure; non-self as self." From these four distortions comes craving; "through craving, they perform the karma that generates rebirth". Venerable Miào Jìng: craving is the moisture.

quiz.q: Loving-kindness begins with "one loved one, one enemy, one neutral person." Do the masters give the same order?
options: Miào Jìng follows the text: loved, enemy, neutral; Cháng Bǎi reorders to loved, neutral, then enemy
quiz.why: "First generate vivid understanding with respect to one loved one, one enemy, and one neutral person." Venerable Miào Jìng: start simply — one loved person, one hated person, one neutral person. Master Cháng Bǎi: first the loved, then the neutral, finally the enemy, since the motivation to give an enemy happiness is weak.

quiz.q: One wishes beings blameless sensory pleasure, pleasure with joy, pleasure without joy. Why no fourth dhyāna, according to Master Cháng Bǎi?
options: the fourth dhyāna is neither pain nor pleasure — equanimity
quiz.why: "Whether blameless sensory pleasure, blameless pleasure with joy, or blameless pleasure free of joy." Master Cháng Bǎi: the fourth dhyāna is not mentioned because its merit is equanimous feeling — neither painful nor pleasant.

quiz.q: "I myself wish for happiness" is inner-body contemplation. Does Master Cháng Bǎi say loving-kindness includes oneself?
options: yes — wishing oneself benefit and happiness too
quiz.why: "'Just as this person is, to me, a loved one, an enemy, or a neutral person, I myself likewise wish for happiness and turn away from suffering.' This is called contemplation of the inner body." Master Cháng Bǎi: the object of loving-kindness includes oneself — wishing oneself benefit and happiness too.

quiz.q: Body-only mindfulness "takes only colour, shape, outward appearance." How does Venerable Miào Jìng explain colour and shape?
options: blue, yellow, red, white are colour; long, short, square, round are shape
quiz.why: "If the practitioner takes up only the mark of form — that is, colour, shape, and outward appearance." Venerable Miào Jìng: colour means blue, yellow, red, white; shape means long, short, square, round.

quiz.q: Past loved ones and enemies "far exceed what confident understanding constructs." How does Master Cháng Bǎi distinguish the two engagements?
options: confident understanding concerns this life; true-reality engagement extends to past and future
quiz.why: "From beginningless time, the loved ones, enemies, and neutral persons who have passed away number beyond measure — far exceeding what confident understanding alone constructs." Master Cháng Bǎi: confident understanding concerns this life, the present practice; true-reality engagement concerns past and future — time is stretched out.

quiz.q: Beings "through ignorance perceive impermanence yet conceive permanence." How does Venerable Miào Jìng describe delusion?
options: of a hundred matters, perhaps wise in one, ignorant in ninety-nine
quiz.why: "Beings, through various kinds of ignorance and delusion, directly perceive impermanence yet falsely conceive it as permanent." Venerable Miào Jìng: of a hundred matters, one may have a little wisdom about one, but about ninety-nine there is no wisdom.

quiz.q: "Through craving, they perform rebirth-generating karma." How does Venerable Miào Jìng distinguish craving and ignorance?
options: craving moistens rebirth; ignorance initiates karma
quiz.why: "Through craving, they perform the fundamental karma that generates rebirth." Venerable Miào Jìng: craving is spoken of in terms of moistening rebirth; ignorance in terms of initiating karma.
